key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut handled by GNOME Shell to control NeMote dictation.

key.name: shortcut-mode
key.description: Whether the shortcut toggles dictation or starts it while held and stops it when released.

key.name: shortcut-capture-active
key.description: Internal coordination flag used to release the active shortcut while preferences records a new one.

key.name: backend
key.description: Selected ASR backend exposed by the NeMote service.

key.name: model-profile
key.description: Internal model format identifier; the model choice selects English or Multilingual.

key.name: model-family
key.description: Whether the selected profile uses the multilingual or dedicated English model.

key.name: streaming-latency-ms
key.description: Streaming chunk duration in milliseconds, selected from the installed model's supported contexts.

key.name: input-device
key.description: Microphone name or miniaudio index. Empty means the system default input device.

key.name: language
key.description: Target language prompt. Available values depend on the selected model family.

key.name: model-root
key.description: Directory containing installed NeMote model profiles. Empty means the service default.

key.name: worker-path
key.description: Path to the NeMote ASR worker binary. Empty means the service default.

key.name: model-installer-path
key.description: Path to the NeMote model installer wrapper. Empty means the service default.

key.name: num-threads
key.description: Number of intra-op threads used by the ASR worker.

key.name: sample-rate
key.description: Input sample rate requested from the capture backend.

key.name: spoken-punctuation
key.description: Enable spoken punctuation handling in the service.

key.name: insert-partials
key.description: Show replaceable preedit text while speaking, then commit the finalized transcript. When disabled, insert finalized text only.

key.name: itn
key.description: Use NeMo's bundled grammars to format spoken numbers, dates, amounts and units on finalized transcripts. NeMo backend only.

key.name: endpoint-mode
key.description: Disabled: finalize on Stop only. Preview: normalize a provisional snapshot at pauses without finalizing recognition. Commit: normalize and commit each utterance at pauses. The ITN switch controls normalization.

key.name: boost-phrases
key.summary: Names and phrases to boost, one per line

key.name: boost-tokenizer-path
key.summary: Optional matching SentencePiece tokenizer for older GGUFs

key.name: vad-model-path
key.summary: Path to a compatible Silero VAD GGUF

key.name: stream-insert-delay-ms
key.description: Additional delay before inserting streaming text, in milliseconds.

key.name: show-overlay
key.description: Deprecated compatibility setting for the previous on-screen dictation overlay.
